Jackie - 74-75

19 Mrs. Rose Ellis - 47 - mother of large fam. Something like diabetis - feet swell, etc. - hard to do her work.

Mrs. Alex'a Makerewicz - 54 - "shaking paralysis ...! her daughter Felician nun.

Mrs. Eliz. Sally - 62 - threatened with inward cancer.
